# Lean Sporty

> Lean Sporty (leansporty.com) is an online dance-fitness studio for women — short, beginner-friendly, follow-along dance workout videos you do at home with no equipment and no experience needed. The flagship product is the 21-Day Dance Challenge: 15 video sessions spread over 21 days, taught by Anastasiia, a professional choreographer and dancer. Day 1 is free to try. The full program is a one-time payment of €49 (no subscription) with a full year of access.

## Key facts

- Made for women — especially those 30+ — who want to enjoy moving again, including complete beginners and people who haven't exercised in years.
- Every session is a follow-along video: you can pause, repeat, and go at your own pace. No gym, no equipment, nothing to install — it works in the browser on a phone, tablet, or laptop.
- Pricing: the 21-Day Dance Challenge is a one-time €49 payment with 12 months of access and no recurring charges. Day 1 is completely free and acts as the trial; because access is digital and immediate, purchases are not refundable.
- After payment the whole program unlocks at once — you can follow the 21-day rhythm or go at your own schedule.
- Instructors can teach on Lean Sporty and keep 85% of every sale they bring (featured instructors keep 90%). Details: https://leansporty.com/teach

## Guides (honest answers about dance fitness)

- [What actually happens in a 21-day dance challenge](https://leansporty.com/guides/21-day-dance-challenge-results): honest week-by-week results timeline; 21-days-to-a-habit is a myth (real average: 66 days) — a challenge is a habit-starter.
- [Is dancing a good workout for women over 30?](https://leansporty.com/guides/dance-workout-women-over-30): benefits, MET-based intensity numbers, realistic timelines.
- [Dance workouts for complete beginners at home](https://leansporty.com/guides/beginner-dance-workout-at-home): what follow-along means, what you need, first-session honesty.
- [How many calories does a dance workout burn?](https://leansporty.com/guides/calories-burned-dance-workout): ~150–250 kcal per 30 minutes; full table by body weight and session length.
- [Low-impact cardio without jumping](https://leansporty.com/guides/low-impact-cardio-no-jumping): knee-friendly, apartment-quiet cardio that is still real exercise.
- [How to start exercising again after years off](https://leansporty.com/guides/start-exercising-again-after-years): restart advice with a realistic week-by-week timeline.
